description:
Mouth-watering Lapland
Step into our restaurant in heart of Rovaniemi and let the unique atmosphere take you to the journey of fells and wilderness. Be delighted by the flavours of  Lapland prepared from fresh Arctic ingredients.
DigiPro is specialised in consulting, coaching, lecturing and publishing in the field of electronic commerce.

Art explores the world from a northern perspective in Korundi House of Culture in Rovaniemi, Lapland, Finland. The home of Rovaniemi Art Museum and Lapland Chamber Orchestra is a hub for art lovers and its creators.

Arctic Hotel Collection is a collection of two family-owned unique hotels with outstanding facilities in Rovaniemi, the capital of Lapland. We offer warm and friendly hospitality, fabulous dining options in our range of restaurants.

We arrange quality bus trips at home and abroad. Our buses are modern and well equipt and most importantly, always in good condition. Our drivers are multilingual and very experienced. Northern European roads and conditions are familiar to us.
Cabins for hire in Rovaniemi.

Restaurant, event venue and catering services in the wonderful nature of Rovaniemi.

Royal Reindeer Ounasvaara, locally known as Ounasvaaran Maja offers a genuine Lapland atmosphere and an authentic environment for all moments and occasions in life near Rovaniemi center.

This old log house has served as a gathering place for locals and tourists for over 70 years. Our expertise is in events and we organize various events throughout the year for large and small groups.

We're open daily from end of November until March serving breakfast and dinner buffet.

Glowing Ember’s provides unforgettable dinner experiences in a atmospheric hut milieu.

Open for private groups (four to twenty persons)

Book your experience: sales@glowingember.net
LAURI is the only historical log house complex in Rovaniemi city centre. Here we make valuable crafts since 1924. Visit our atelier, stay at our guesthouse or rent our premises for your event.

Travel to the Arctic Circle and come to relax in the Lappish nature or at the Arctic seaside.
Santa’s Hotels has the best holiday destinations for you: First-class dining, high-quality hotel rooms, premium glass igloos, full-service chalets and fully-equipped apartments.
Mountain bike rentals and guided rides in Lapland.

As The Original Aurora Hunters™, we pride ourselves on our unrivaled expertise in capturing the mesmerizing dance of the Northern Lights and curating other spellbinding travel experiences since the 1600s.

Beyond Arctic is the leading tour company in Finnish Lapland with a specialization in photography. We create exclusive excursions in the heart of Lapland and take you to locations of staggering beauty. We have been pioneering operator in photography travel since 2016 and with our team you are guaranteed to experience and photograph Lapland in its most pristine and authentic form.

Small-groups, premium service and tailor-made adventures are the features that set us apart from many other services in Lapland. Our pledge is to show you the real and authentic Arctic nature away from crowds in the most sustainable way. With our professional local guides, you will experience a great deal of personal service accompanied by true Lappish hospitality and attention even to the smallest detail. Get ready for the experience of a lifetime and join our team to dive Beyond the Arctic.
no. 1 Floating water parks in Finland

Now you can feel the fun of driving on ice safely with our new icekart cars. After a short driving lesson and safety information, you are ready for the track. 
You don´t need driving license or previous driving experience is required. Come and experience Santa´s fun ice track karting with your own senses.

New in the market - 35 years experience with horses behind us.  Aurora Horses is family owned company, and not just a company but our passion. Our camp is located only 8km from Rovaniemi City Center.

We offer sleigh ride and horseback riding tours with lovely Finnhorses!
Tuotteiden kuratoija Ruka-Kuusamo matkailualue

The Sauna raft m/s Erkin Arkki cruises the scenic rivers Ounasjoki and Kemijoki from June to October. The tar scenting m/s Erkin Arkki has a wood heated sauna in which bathing takes place in a traditional style. You can bathe as the ferry sails and view the beautiful landscape.

DMC Rovaniemi is a destination management company based in the heart of Rovaniemi and Lapland. We specialize in offering a full range of DMC services, ensuring that your experience in this breathtaking part of the world is safe, reliable, and unforgettable.

Pure Lapland is a local family business from Rovaniemi, offering travelers activities and adventures year-round. With us you get to try your skills e.g. with ice fishing, fly through the woods with real Siberian Huskies and feel the adrenaline rush with snowmobiles and quad bikes. You can also enjoy the amazing midnight sun and the northern lights!
We are water activity center Roiske. We offer multiple activities in the scenery of beautiful river Ounas during summer- and wintertime.

Located in the middle of Santa Claus Village, Piparina Day cabins and dining offers private gingerbread cabins and high-quality Lapland culinary experiences. 15 private cabins are available for hourly rental during the day. In the day cabins, guests can relax, order food and drinks from the restaurant, enjoy their own snacks, or even host meetings and celebrations. 
In the restaurant (formerly known as Santamus), the guests can enjoy our new food concept, Taste of Lapland menu. Taste of Lapland menu consists of tasting-sized portions of various Lapland delicacies from reindeer and lake fish to king crab, allowing guests to create their own culinary journey.

District Rovaniemi Oy is a company that is owned and operated in Finland. It is registered and licensed in Finland with its main office located in Rovaniemi. Our team has travelled extensively all over the world and has a passion for extreme sports and nature. We provide something new for people, who already have seen it all. Our main goal is to create unforgettable moments in Lapland and give You something that others can’t.

Each member of our team is a specialist in their fields. Together, we make sure your experience will be unforgettable.

Lapland Safaris are specialists in Lapland’s nature and the Lappish lifestyle. Since 1982, we have provided tourists visiting Lapland with exciting nature activities and memorable travel experiences.

COOL AND PURE EXPERIENCES SINCE 1982
Lapland Safaris are specialists in Lapland’s nature and the Lappish lifestyle. Since 1982, we have provided tourists visiting Lapland with exciting nature activities and memorable travel experiences. At the heart of our activities lies the culture of Lapland. We draw inspiration from the local history and day-to-day ‘Lappishness’. The stories and legends related to these principles form the basis of the programme packages offered to our customers.

Learn, take part, laugh
Lapland Safaris has high-quality standards for its products and its employees, in particular with safety issues. Lapland Safaris was awarded an ISO 9001 quality certificate in 2000 – the first event organisation agency in the world to receive one. In 2011, Lapland Safaris received the National Tourism Safety award. First in Lapland and first in the business.

The principle ”learn, take part, laugh” provides a guideline for our quality policy. Every guest is taken into the middle of the action to participate in and learn about new, interesting experiences – all in the spirit of good fun, of course. Guests get to conquer the wilderness of Lapland while knowing that they are safe at all times.

IGLOOS: Imagine a world of ice and snow!
THE NORTHERN LIGHTS:The Northern Lights in their full glory.
SNOWMOBILING: Experience the thrill of driving a snowmobile through snowy forests.
ARCTIC ANIMALS: Reindeer safari, Husky safari, Ranua Zoo.
CROSS-COUNTRY SKIING & SNOWSHOES
ICE-FISHING SAFARIS
MIDNIGHT SUN: Experience the magical nights of the Arctic summer
THE SANTA CLAUS VILLAGE
RIVER CRUISES: An enchanting river full of experiences
You can explore Lapland’s nature independently, too. Lapland Safaris offer hikers tips about attractions and a wide selection of quality hiking and outdoor equipment for hire, such as snowshoes and winter clothing.

Our hearts beat for the arctic nature
The nature of Lapland is the most sensitive member of our team. We observe the principles of sustainable development and scale all of our activities according to the tolerance of the natural environment. We guide our guests to respect nature and to get close with it in a Lappish way, allowing them to enjoy their nature outing with a clean conscience.

Biggest and most experienced event organiser in the Nordic countries
We are active in seven locations across Lapland: Rovaniemi, Ylläs, Saariselkä, Kemi, Levi, Luosto, Olos – all within an hour’s drive from an airport.

Capacity to accept 8,000 guests a day.
Winter gear available for 12,500 and summer gear for 850 people.
500 trained employees in season.
50 employees around the year.
150,000 guests a year.
450 snowmobiles, 40 canoes and 7 punt-boats.
Own guide school.
Privately-owned DMC and member of AFTA.
Local Food Finland offers the widest selection of authentic Finnish dishes in Rovaniemi — all in one visit.

Arctic Joy is a small local business by the Arctic Circle in Rovaniemi, Finland.
All activities are nature based and focus on your well being, relaxation, authenticity and sustainability. Choose from our pre planned activities or ask for a customized adventure based on your exact needs and wishes.
Cosy hostel & café in the heart of Rovaniemi.

Villa Vinkkeli is a new art center in Ounasmetsä, Rovaniemi. The house has an art gallery and the photo studio of photographer Kaisa Sirén. Villa Vinkkeli can also host cultural events. Other than art gallery shows, we have photography show evenings, workshops, courses, art sale events and local culture events for travelers.

We are a group of student entrepreneurs aiming to offer Fresh – Green – Authentic Saigon Taste. Our food combines the best of flavors, textures, emotion and art. We have amazing different kinds of noodles as well as handmade bubble tea or milk tea, friendly services and photogenic corners for check in!

Casa Arctica is a family owned accommodation offering one cabin and three apartments in central Rovaniemi. We aim to provide friendly and high-quality accommodation for all of our guests!

Our cabin and apartments are located in the city centre, less than a kilometre from Lordi’s Square. You can stay in atmospheric guesthouse, beautiful apartment, stunnig sauna Studio or modern city studio. 

All of them are beautifully furnished and well-equipped. Three of them have a private sauna. Free WiFi and private, free parking are included in the price. Our apartments provide you with the perfect base to explore Rovaniemi, the city of Santa Claus. You can find our home office in the same address as the guesthouse, Pirttitie 17. Our family will ensure you have a pleasant and happy stay. 

When you wish to have more than a hotel room our apartments are your home away!

Hiljaisuus ry on kittiläläinen taide- ja kulttuurialan asiantuntija sekä taiteellisen työn ympäristö. Yhdistys toteuttaa erilaisia tapahtumia, kehittää taide- ja kulttuurialan toimintaedellytyksiä, tukee taiteilijoiden ammattimaista työtä sekä tuo korkatasoisia taidesisältöjä yleisöjen ulottuville Lapissa.

Santa Line is a service entirety for incentive and tour operator customers provided by Rovaniemi Taxi Service. We also provide services for business travelers and demanding VIPs or groups. We operate in the Rovaniemi district of Finnish Lapland.
The 24 Premium Glass Apartments at Glass Resort are designed to combine Lapland tradition, modern comfort and the pure nature of the Arctic Circle.

Are you attracted to northern forests? If so, your place is Pilke in Rovaniemi in Finnish Lapland near the Arctic Circle. The science centre's exhibitions will allow you to explore current forest issues, while the Pilke Shop offers forest products that appeal to all of the senses.

Check the opening hours from our website www.sciencecentrepilke.fi.

Lapland Private is a privately owned Destination Management Company in Finnish Lapland, offering tailor-made travel experiences and personalized holiday itineraries for independent travel groups, private groups, and incentive travel parties.

Our bespoke travel itineraries are designed to meet each client’s specific needs and desires, allowing them to experience Lapland’s magic fully. We work closely with clients to create personalized packages for family adventures, luxury retreats, romantic getaways, and nature escapes.

With a vast network of reliable, ethical, and professional partners, we design truly authentic and engaging experiences that utilize the entire region as our playground. We carefully select service providers to fit the specific needs of each client, ensuring that every trip is unique and unforgettable.

Our exclusive services include local travel agents, personalized support, experiences by the best providers, optimal chances to see the Northern Lights, Multi-destination travel plans, a range of accommodation options all around Lapland and more.

Our team’s personal touch, “everything is possible” attitude, attention to detail, and excellent organizational skills shine through in our unique Lapland Holiday itineraries.

We take pride in delivering high-quality travel experiences that meet our clients’ exact requirements, tailoring programs to meet personal travel budgets to make our services available to everyone.

At Lapland Private, our only standard is to provide exceptional and unforgettable holidays in Lapland.
Valley Shop is a store specializing in Moomin products in Santa Claus Village in Rovaniemi

Boutique Apart Hotel Haawe - privacy, memorable details, and perfected design
Located in a historical building in Rovaniemi, Lapland, Haawe features 14 individually decorated rooms where the magic of Lapland’s nature meets high-quality design. With a unique atmosphere and excellent location, Haawe offers its guests accommodation with a difference and easy access to arctic adventures.
Rooms vary from comfortable 2-person superior rooms to luxurious 5-person suites with spa rooms and a sauna. In each room, you will find distinct details inspired by Lapland’s nature and its phenomena, a well-equipped kitchen with quality appliances, and Finnish design classics. With only 14 rooms, we can ensure our guests’ privacy. We welcome all guests in person and offer our guests supplies for a do-it-yourself breakfast, tailored to their diet.

At Helios Tour, we strive to provide personalized and professional destination management services in Lapland for families with children, tourist groups and VIP clients.

Helios Tour offers a complete, full-service destination management:

accommodation solutions (hotels, cottages, bed and breakfast, private apartments)
transportation and logistics
budget management
catering
multilingual guides
Helios Tour programs:
unique programs for children: Adventures in the Trolls forest, Secret of the Snow Queen, Meeting with Santa Claus family
individually tailored trips for VIP clients
in winter: safaris and excursions, snowmobile, husky, reindeer, ice-fishing
in summer: river-rafting, canoeing, off-road kart safari, hiking, hiking trips with huskies, picnics, wilderness cooking courses and various excursions, fishing trips
nature activities, sports and culture events, camp and education programmes throughout the year
Our experience is diverse and ranges from welcoming VIP clients at government prime ministers and corporate top management level to destination management support for TV reality-shows filming.

Helios Tour is awarded an AAA-certificate of quality issued by Soliditet.

More information is available at www.heliostour.fi.

Lapland is an ideal destination for a family holiday, offering a wide variety of activities and attractions for all ages.

WELCOME TO THE LAPLAND FAIRYTALE!
Our hotel combines modern, high-quality rooms, affordable rates, warm-hearted service and beautiful nature in one place on the riverside of Rovaniemi city - the capital of Lapland.

Luxury Action is the pioneering private travel company with focus on tailored Nordic destination experiences. Our headquater is based in Rovaniemi in Finnish Lapland, and sales office in Stockholm, Sweden. We create high-end experiences and expeditions across the Nordic countries and European Arctic: Lapland, Finland and the rest of the Nordic region, including Greenland, Svalbard and even North Pole. All our tours are highly customised according to the customers’ wishes.
At Luxury Action nothing is impossible. We aim to build a deep connection with the traveller and the destination. We believe in ‘new luxury’ in travel, where we combine authentic environment and eco-luxury to high-end hospitality. We have access to private locations and properties available nowhere else. Facilities beyond luxury, sustainability at heart, in addition to world-class services, comfort and ultimate privacy, Luxury Action’s adventures offer magical experiences for travellers who will return home content, rejuvenated and reconnected with self and the nature.
At Luxury Action we do everything with passion. Enthusiasm, attention to detail, and a warm and willing heart – these are the absolute key words for Luxury Action, which sets us apart from others.

Luxury Action now also owns the DMC Authentic Lapland and the safari house Arctic circle Snowmobilepark in Rovaniemi and Levi.

Beebike is a bike shop and service in the centre of Rovaniemi. We also rent bikes! Everyone bike touring and bikepacking are warmly welcome. When you mention that you are on the road you will be serviced swiftly. Don't be shy. Our staff speaks several languages.
Arctra DMC Ltd. is a nordic Destination Management Company specialised in private luxury travel experiences in Lapland – We craft unforgettable stays that exceeds your expectations

We are a young charter company. Our offices are located in Rovaniemi and Lahti. During the winter, we also operate in the Fell Lapland area.

Together with our partners, we are able to arrange a comprehensive travel package taking into account the customer's needs and requirements.

Game trips, theater trips, class trips and even slightly longer trips are organized through us. We can also offer our expertise in bus travel to Russia.

Even for large groups, the Charter runs are handled through us with high-quality and clean equipment. Our drivers are professional and customer service minded.

Welcome to Bearhill Husky, Rovaniemi’s premier independent husky kennel. The company was founded in 2003 in Lieksa in North Karelia and since 2012 we have been offering high quality sleddog tours in Rovaniemi. It’s our passion to work with dogs, breed them, train them and let them be the best dogs they can be.
At Bearhill, both our dogs and guests deserve the best!

Santa Claus Reindeer is a family-owned company offering authentic reindeer experiences year-round in Rovaniemi, on the Arctic Circle. We welcome visitors to meet and connect with our reindeer at two unique locations: in the heart of Santa Claus Village and at our remote reindeer farm, surrounded by peaceful Lappish nature.

At Santa Claus Reindeer, reindeer welfare is our foundation. Every reindeer is respected as an individual – with rest days, proper nutrition, space to roam, and care that honors both tradition and modern animal wellbeing standards.

In the winter, guests can enjoy traditional reindeer sleigh rides through snowy forests and learn about reindeer herding as a way of life in Lapland. During the summer and autumn, we invite you to visit and feed our reindeer, hear stories of reindeer herding traditions, and immerse yourself in the everyday work of a reindeer herder.

You are warmly welcome to discover the spirit of Lapland with Santa Claus Reindeer!

Visit Rovaniemi is the local tourist board of the Rovaniemi region in Lapland, Finland. Visit Rovaniemi engages in image and joint marketing, media visits, communications and PR and tourist information.

Visit Rovaniemi's tasks in brief:
1) Uphold and strengthen the “Rovaniemi, the Official Hometown of Santa Claus” brand 2) Promote Rovaniemi as an international travel destination 3) Coordinate regional joint marketing efforts 4) Maintain Rovaniemi a subject in international media 5) Provide tourist information services for Rovaniemi 6) Handle sales of tourism related products and services
Lapland Fishing Ltd. focuses providing fishing experiences for lifetime!
Villa Virpi was build in mid 1900's. We offer accommodation and unique experiences in authentic atmosphere and cozy house in Rovaniemi and Lapland.
Lapland Welcome is an incoming office, destination management company and program service operator in Lapland Finland. We have got offfices in Rovaniemi, Kemi, Katkavaara and Inari-Saariselka.

Located 15km north from Rovaniemi’s city centre, by the side of the Ounas River, Nova Galaxy Village is a resort of unique Scandinavian style Aurora huts. 

Safari activities for Nova’s guests only, such as husky and snowmobile experience, are also available directly at the Village and operated everyday.

The village has only 10 Aurora huts for a more private setting, a reception building, its own restaurant for guests and other facilities for the safari activities.

Nova Galaxy Village is a quiet and isolated place where you will enjoy Lapland’s nature at its best and have more chance to see the auroras for a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

Visiting a traditional Finnish sauna is a must-do for everyone coming to Lapland. At our Arctos Lapland spa we offer you the opportunity to fully experience this important part of Finnish culture in a winter wonderland setting, located 15 minutes away from Rovaniemi central and Santa Claus village.

Combine the wood-heated sauna with a plunge in the (frozen) lake or just relax and unwind in the hot tub, the best place to leave the stress and pressures of modern live behind. Since this is a private event you will have the sauna, hot tub and ice-dipping hole completely for yourself.

Lapland Pro Awarded tour operator and DMC based in Finnish Lapland. With local knowledge and years of experience, we offer first-class services from flights to excursions and accommodation to arrangements for VIP-guests. We are the experts of group and B2B travel services, including incentive and corporate travel, leisure groups and high-end luxury tours.

Guesthouse Borealis is a low-cost, friendly family-managed bed and breakfast, where the owner and staff take care of the guests ' wellbeing. The company enjoys a quiet location, just a stroll away from the center of town. Train and bus connections approx. 300 m from our accommodation.

The rooms are comfortable single, twin and triple rooms, each with a small en suite. Guesthouse Borealis also has two apartments with private entrances. Apartment 1 is a six-bed apartment with two bedrooms and a kitchenette/lounge area. Apartment 2 sleeps 4 and has a private sauna.

Rovaniemi Wellness Tours by the Arctic Circle provides memorable experiences for small groups by doing together. In our services we are inspired of holistic wellbeing. Notice, that you have access to our programs also with a wheel chair. Welcome!

From Hiking tours to Wildlife Safaris, Northern Lights hunt, Ice fishing or Snowshoeing, Visiting the one and only Santa Claus in Rovaniemi and many other Unique tours.

Here is something for every kind of traveller with Wonderlapland !
We specialise in small group trips for active, adventurous Individuals, Couples and families looking for a memorable experience.

We will provide our expert knowledge, exciting itineraries and friendly staff and take you under the skin of Lapland for the adventure of a lifetime.

​Our average group tour size is just 8; perfect for meeting new people and getting to the heart of our destinations.
Wonderlapland caters to every type of traveller no matter their Age, Budget or Adventure style.

YellowSnow Guides offers exclusive tailor-made experiences in the mountains of Lapland, in MTB, e-MTB, Trail running,  Skiing and Ski touring. We focus on high quality at every stage of the trips. You will be in good hands throughout the experience, everyone in our team are trained and skilled professionals. We have certificate of International Mountain guiding IFMGA-UIAGM, SBO Svenska Bergsguideorganisation (Swedish mountain guides organisation), and Mountain bike instructor qualification of MIAS Level 3. We are born in Lapland and the culture lives deep in our hearts.

Invisible Forest Lodge is a unique luxury accommodation in the Arctic Circle, Rovaniemi, Lapland where you can experience tranquility and comfort of 13 boutique suite cabins surrounded by Arctic forest. Every suite is strategically positioned to ensure each guest can fully immerse themselves in the beauty of the surrounding nature without any disturbances.

Samarund is a family business, established in 2002. We offer a wide range of domestic personalised wooden, reindeer and steel gifts. 

We warmly welcome you to visit our shop in Rovaniemi to see our selection.

You are served by Sami and Elmeri.

Arktikum is a science centre and museum that lets you experience northern nature, culture, and history up close. Housing the University of Lapland’s Arctic Centre and the Regional Museum of Lapland, we stimulate thought, encourage debate, and provide a deeper understanding of the Arctic.

Restaurant Valdemari is a cosy privately owned restaurant situated in Rovaniemi.  Easiest way to get to Valdemari from the centre of Rovaniemi is by heading across the Jätkänkynttilä bridge. Valdemari is just by the bridge, next to the beach. Walking distance is only about 500 meters. Our restaurant is well known since 1994 of excellent food and service with a smile. We also have catering service.

Restaurant Valdemari has good facilities for meetings, different happenings and private parties.

At summer time we have the only riverside terrace in the town with breathtaking view by the Kemijoki river.  A part of our terrace is covered and there is possible to organize meetings or private functions with dinner service in summertime. Covered terrace has own stage.

We offer exceptional catering services for corporate jets at Rovaniemi Airport (EFRO) and our services are also available at Kittilä Airport (EFKT), Ivalo Airport (EFIV)  Kemi Airport (EFKE) and Kuusamo(EFKS)

Bucket list vacation at Santa Claus Holiday Village!

Christmas magic all year round! All of our rooms include sauna, kitchenette and your own Christmas tree! You can choose your accommodation from our classic or superior cabin rooms or different type of suites.

We offer high class accommodation, restaurants and safari products every day of the year. Our special product is that you can book the Santa Claus himself to visit your room!
Choose your own accommodation package according to your needs from below or ask more.

Santa Claus Holiday Village:
159 rooms
Reception open 24/7
Choose apartment between the Classic cottages, Superior cottages or Suites
3 restaurants
Safaris & Santa's office
3 souvenir shops
A fantastic location
- 5 minutes from the Rovaniemi airport.
- 1 minutes walk to visit Santa Claus

VÄKI - Deep in the forests of Lapland, on the mirror-smooth surface of the lakes and in the whisper of the wind lives an ancient power, väki. It is the spirit of the forest, the wisdom of the water, the power of the earth and the whisper of the air. In Finnish folklore, väki is invisible, but it can be sensed - and for those who listen, it tells ancient stories of the connection between nature and humans.

As a company, we produce services that connect and support each other; activity and nature services. We have a fitness center offering bouldering and weekly classes from yoga to pilates. All of these are to support an active lifestyle. In addition to this, we have created nature services to strengthen a more holistic well-being and to bring services to the middle of the natural phenomena of Lapland. With us, you can enjoy and experience the phenomenon of the midnight sun and the crackle of the northern lights. Welcome to Väki!

Lapland X Tours, located in Rovaniemi, specializes in small group and personalized adventures, including Northern Lights and Photography Tours. Our passion radiates through every journey, creating memories that last a lifetime.
We are reliable, transparent, and devoted to exceptional service, establishing us as a trusted partner. Our focus on personalized, high-quality experiences prioritizes customer satisfaction and cultivates enduring partnerships.

Come, see and live experiences you’ll remember fur-ever!
The enthusiasm of running dogs, the atmosphere of old days and the exoticism of Lapland. Meet the genuine Siberian Huskies, enjoy the environment and get thrilled by the speed of the sled!

Rovaniemi Theatre is the northernmost professional theatre in EU. Our skillful staff of 50 professionals produce and perform over 300 events in a year from musicals and dramas to weddings and conferences. 
Theatre is located in Rovaniemi city centre in a gourgeous and esteemed Lappia House. Lappia House was designed by world-known arcitecht and designer Alvar Aalto. The house itself is worth a visit and under it's mountain shaped roof is also art and exhibitions. The lobby is also a home to our theatre themed shop where you can find unique Finnish design items such as cards, accessories, jewelry and more!

Porovaara is a family-owned reindeer farm and private nature retreat, just 20 minutes from Rovaniemi city center. Escape the crowds and discover authentic Lapland activities, surrounded by the peaceful silence of nature.

Step into a wonderful world at Silver Birch Resort,
where every moment is a journey into the magic of
Finnish Lapland. Nestled amidst the breathtaking
beauty of nature, our exclusive, lake-view cabins
offer the perfect sanctuary for a 3- or 4-night Arctic
retreat within 5 hectares of pristine wilderness.

We take care of every detail, arranging your airport
and city center transfers, and offering delicious
breakfasts and dinners served daily in our private
restaurant, exclusive to resort guests. Our chefs
create delicious menus with family-friendly options,
ensuring tasty meals for even the most finicky of eaters.
Throughout the day, embark on spectacular tours
for unforgettable glimpses into Lapland’s magic.

At Silver Birch Resort, each of our guests will find joy,
excitement, and relaxation in the heart of Finnish Lapland.

Nestled on the slopes of Ounasvaara fell and surrounded by serene northern landscapes, the resort features elegantly crafted panorama chalets offering breathtaking views and unobstructed sights of the Northern Lights.

Kotatieva Resort is a unique winter destination located just 10 km from the centre of Rovaniemi. Nestled in a peaceful snowy forest, it’s the perfect place to escape the city lights and experience the magic of Lapland.

At the resort, visitors can enjoy a wide range of winter activities, including our one-of-a-kind forest ice-skating trail, sledding, ice bowling, snowshoe disc golf, snowshoeing, sliding snowshoes, and plenty of snow play. A warm and cosy changing room, an open fire for toasting sausages, and a welcoming café add to the comfort and charm of the visit.

During the winter season, guests can also meet our friendly reindeer and experience traditional reindeer sleigh rides. In the evenings, our Aurora Skating on Private Sauna and Hot Tub offer a magical chance to witness the northern lights dancing across the Arctic sky. You can also enjoy a delicious dinner made from local ingredients in our atmospheric log restaurant, Restaurant Kotatieva, or savour salmon cooked over an open fire.

Accommodation is offered in charming, small cabins, providing a cosy and peaceful stay in the heart of nature – perfect for a short visit or an extended holiday.

Kotatieva Resort is suitable for all ages and offers unforgettable moments in the serene beauty of Lapland!

YourBus is a trusted charter bus company in Rovaniemi, offering comfortable and reliable transportation for groups of all sizes. Whether you’re planning airport transfers, Lapland sightseeing tours, corporate travel, or private group transportation, we provide safe and punctual service tailored to your needs.

Welcome to our small, family-operated Finnish homestead. In our cozy stable, you'll have the opportunity to meet our friendly horses, dogs, and sheep. Our stable is home to Finnish horses and Fjord horses. We offer a variety of horse-related activities, including trail riding, sleigh rides in the winter, and we also breed Finnish horses. You are also welcome to join our traditional sauna ceremony or experience the tranquility of nature by staying in our glampings.

During your visit, we'll share fascinating insights into the lives and histories of these magnificent animals. Our location is conveniently situated approximately 55 kilometers from Rovaniemi City Center, 50 kilometers from Luosto, and 70 kilometers from Sodankylä. Come and immerse yourself in authentic rural experiences with us!

Visiting Korvala's restaurant and café is like taking a step back in time. Our place offers a unique opportunity to experience local specialities, showcasing traditional meals and freshly baked sweet and savoury snacks. These are served in either one of the two dining rooms, each furnished in the style that is typical of Lapland's log houses from the 1800s.

Book Lapland is a premier tour company specializing in unforgettable experiences under the Arctic skies. We offer expertly guided tours that bring the magic of Lapland to life, with a focus on aurora hunting, providing our guests the best possible chance to witness the stunning northern lights. Our team, deeply rooted in local knowledge and passion, ensures that every adventure is both authentic and extraordinary. Whether you're seeking the thrill of aurora chasing or other winter activities, Book Lapland is dedicated to making your Arctic dreams a reality.

Apukka Resort is a premier glass igloo hotel in Rovaniemi, only a 20-minute drive from the city center, 15 minutes from the airport, and 10 minutes from Santa Claus Village.

Our resort offers a wide range of glass igloos in different shapes and sizes. Whether you’re traveling as a couple, with family, friends, or on your own, you are warmly welcome. Each igloo features large windows that open up to the surrounding nature, letting the beauty of Lapland flow inside.
